cases.name: the metrics assertion stops following the constant
the streams are opened and dropped rather than held
only one stream is opened, so nothing is held at once
cases.expect_survivor: the constant sizes the demonstration and cannot be load-bearing: the whole finding is that the node does not distinguish one open stream from ten, so every assertion follows the constant rather than pinning it. Ten is chosen so a reader cannot mistake the result for a scheduling accident; one is a weaker demonstration of the same true thing.

cases.name: the node is started without the concurrency limit
cases.expect_survivor: also the finding. A node with no limit admits ten streams and so does one limited to a single request, because the permit is released before a row is read. Catching this would mean the limit bound on open streams, which is the change this test would fail on deliberately.
